findings.title: Missing tenant isolation predicate in database query
findings.body: Verified ground truth defect matching scenario charter.
findings.suggestion: Add AND org_id = $3 to the WHERE clause to ensure tenant boundary enforcement.

findings.title: Cross-tenant authorization bypass without orgId scoping
findings.body: Verified ground truth defect matching scenario charter.
findings.suggestion: Pass req.user.orgId into memberRepo.updateRole to scope the modification.

findings.title: Hardcoded production API secret key committed as literal
findings.body: Verified ground truth defect matching scenario charter.
findings.suggestion: Load the Stripe secret key from process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY instead of committing literals.

findings.title: Unsanitized dynamic SQL concatenation vulnerability
findings.body: Verified ground truth defect matching scenario charter.
findings.suggestion: Use parameterized queries ($1, $2) rather than template literal interpolation.

findings.title: N+1 sequential database query in loop
findings.body: Verified ground truth defect matching scenario charter.
findings.suggestion: Fetch order items in batch using WHERE order_id = ANY($1) or a SQL JOIN.

findings.title: Synchronous blocking I/O on Express request path
findings.body: Verified ground truth defect matching scenario charter.
findings.suggestion: Use asynchronous fs.promises.readFile and non-blocking child_process.exec.

findings.title: Unbounded in-memory collection growth without eviction
findings.body: Verified ground truth defect matching scenario charter.
findings.suggestion: Implement an LRU cache with maximum capacity and TTL eviction.

findings.title: Inverted layering dependency: Domain importing presentation/HTTP layer
findings.body: Verified ground truth defect matching scenario charter.

findings.title: Circular module dependency between UserService and NotificationService
findings.body: Verified ground truth defect matching scenario charter.

findings.title: Breaking public API signature change without backwards compatibility
findings.body: Verified ground truth defect matching scenario charter.
findings.suggestion: Overload signature or deprecate previous method before introducing breaking options shape.

findings.title: Uncovered error handling and retry fallback branching logic
findings.body: Verified ground truth defect matching scenario charter.
findings.suggestion: Add unit tests exercising currency conversion, soft decline retry, and payment exception logging.

findings.title: Exclusive test marker .only() left active in test suite
findings.body: Verified ground truth defect matching scenario charter.

findings.title: Brittle test asserting private implementation details instead of observable behavior
findings.body: Verified ground truth defect matching scenario charter.
findings.suggestion: Assert on public observable output or received transport payload rather than private variables.

findings.title: Destructive DROP COLUMN migration on active table
